#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    long long b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> c(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        c[i] = (a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
    }
    long long sum = 0;
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int>> pq;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        sum += c[i];
        if (sum == 0) {
            pq.push(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    int count = 0;
    long long total = 0;
    while (!pq.empty() && total + pq.top() <= b) {
        total += pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        ++count;
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
